attributes.action: Single person council tax discount should be 50%, not 25%.
attributes.background: The government or councils or whoever has the authority, should increase the single person discount on the council tax demand from 25% and make it 50%.

rejection.details:
We already have a petition open on this subject asking for the same thing, which you may wish to sign:

Increase the Council Tax Single Person Discount from 25% to 50%
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/771191
